about: THE CAREER: what the player starts with, what things cost, what a win pays, and the Blacklist.
Every number here is read by src/game/career.js, shop.js and activities.js - change it here, reload, done.
THE SCALE is that of the street-racing games this one is modelled on (Need for Speed: Most Wanted, Forza Horizon):
a win pays a few thousand, a part a few thousand, a car tens of thousands. Keep new numbers on that scale.
start        the car the player owns on day one, and the money in their pocket.
streetRace   what beating a street racer pays, for a race of the usual length against a car rated like yours.
A harder rival (rated above you) pays more, an easier one less; a shorter race pays less.
cars         the dealership's price of each car. A car with no price is never for sale (a Blacklist prize).
parts        the garage's price of each performance part: one number for every option of the group,
or a list with one price per option, in the order of upgrades.json.
engineSwap   another engine costs  base + perPs x its power in PS.
bodyPart     the price of any body part (bumper, wing, rims, livery...). Paint is free.
A part is paid for once: after that it belongs to that car and can be refitted for nothing.
ACTIVITIES with one, two and three stars. Each star level pays ONCE, the first time it is reached
(reach three at once and the two skipped are paid too): reputation and money, one number per level.
speedCamera  drive past a camera fast. The cameras, and the speeds their stars ask for, are in each map's map.json.
timeAttack   a route from the cone at any stop, to be driven within the time. kmh = the AVERAGE speed over the run
that each star's time limit is worked out from (so the limits follow from the length of the run; slower
than the first = TIME UP, the run has failed). A map may ask for other speeds:
"timeAttack": { "kmh": [..] } in its map.json - a mountain road is slower than a highway.
blacklist    the drivers to beat, in the order they are listed (the last one is number 1).
reputation  what the player needs before this driver will race them
car, build, look   what they drive (build and look as in the save file; {} = as it left the factory).
Street racers never turn up in a Blacklist driver's car.
raceLength  metres
prize       paid the FIRST time they are beaten: money, reputation - and their car.
Beating them again pays like a street race.
line        a few words about them, shown on the Blacklist screen and in their introduction
colour      their own colour: the glowing lines of their introduction and their card
intro       which introduction plays before the race (src/game/blacklistIntros.js). Every driver has their own.
To add a driver: .claude/skills/speedx-blacklist.
